name: John Van Alen
bio: a Representative from New York; born in Kinderhook, Columbia County, N.Y., in 1749; completed preparatory studies; served in the Revolutionary War, a private in the 7th regiment of the Albany County, N.Y., Militia; moved to Defreestville, N.Y., in 1778;  engaged in extensive farming operations; surveyed the town of Greenbush, N.Y., 1790; and conducted a general store there; engaged in civil engineering and surveying; assistant court justice in Rensselaer County, N.Y., 1791; elected as a Federalist to the Third Congress, and reelected to the two succeeding Congresses (March 4, 1793-March 3, 1799); member of the New York state assembly, 1800 and 1801; died on February 27, 1807, in Defreestville, N.Y. ; interment in Bloomington Rural Cemetery, North Greenbush, N.Y.
